listing.aiSummary: Adds the UNSC, Covenant, and Ancients factions with unique ships, weapons, and stations.

description:
Adds 3 factions: the UNSC, the Covenant, and the Ancients.

DISCLAIMER
- AI is used in the development of this mod.

COMPATABILITY
- Requires Nexerelin.
- Requires LazyLib, GraphicsLib, LunaLib and MagicLib
- NOT COMPATIBLE WITH ORIGINAL OR EXPANDED UNSC MOD.

- Not compatible with Simple Java Upgrader mod as of now.

Most recent release details a partial remaster of the UNSC faction, with the Covenant and Ancients to be done later down the track.

FEATURES:

Spoiler
The Covenant is a high tech and late-game faction to the game to the south east of the core worlds comprising 5 planets. Ships all have high flux cap and dissipation, but Covenant weapon flux usage is correspondingly high, take care when using these weapons on other craft, but have low(ish) armour and hull. EVERYONE HATES THE COVENANT.
Ships have a very high cost, default ships tend to accumulate flux quickly-ish even when firing and not taking damage.

The UNSC is a midline mid-late game faction northeast of the core worlds comprising 4 planets and 2 stations. Their loadouts  favour missiles and ballistic weapons, with unique MACs being sold from their worlds coming in small, medium and large slots (although CANNOT ROTATE so place accordingly). Especially hates the Covenant, and has actual relations with other factions unlike the Covenant.

The Ancients are high-tech and late-game series of hulls, fighters and weapons. They don't have a faction yet so their ships will spawn with Remnant fleets, albeit with a lower chance.

Stations:
The UNSC and Covenant have their unique stations that they use, and can be built by the player if your: rep with the faction is friendly or better.

HULLMODs:
- Shield with code taken from Star Wars mod (I hope that's ok)
- Hullmods from original UNSC mod.
- Some UNSC hullmods added.

Known Issues:
- Backup AI Captains can't cycle right now, and has a placeholder Gamma Core description.

Assets taken from UNSC mod by AppleMarineXX and expansion by StargazerRJL mainly for weapons and some Covenant ships.
Sprites taken from Halo wiki and free-to-access artworks on Artstation by Jared Harris (most sprites from here).
Other sprites made using AI (since I can't art).

Download
Google Drive (may be discontinued):https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EjgjwhRUI16mDH7XR8maKqCeOUtYLZ0q?usp=drive_link
GitHub (finally): https://github.com/ExtremisKO/Halo-HomeSystems
